title: My first day at work
instructions: Sofia yeni işindeki ilk gününü anlatıyor. Olayların sırasına ve duygularına dikkat et.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: Yesterday was my first day at a new company.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: I was very nervous, so I arrived thirty minutes early.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: My manager, Mr Park, showed me the office and introduced me to the team.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: Everyone was friendly. A colleague called Ines took me to lunch.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: In the afternoon, I had some training on the computer system. It was a bit boring.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: I left at five thirty. I was tired, but I think I'm going to like this job.

questions.feedback: Çok gergindi, bu yüzden otuz dakika erken geldi.

questions.feedback: Ines adlı bir iş arkadaşı onu öğle yemeğine götürdü.
